scenario: [RFCS.19.5]'s ascending order holds inside an `Expr` whose `json_tainted` (19) is set beside a oneof member numbered above it. An interpolation with a segment that reads a `Json` projection is tainted as a whole node ([IRET.9.6]), so the `log` action's message is an `Expr` holding `interp` (20) and `json_tainted` (19), and the writer must put 19 first. The program logs `r.payload.depth` from a `Json` slot. `atoms` requires the artefact to hold the `TerminalNode` that carries the action. The harness ([RCTS.1.2.19], `dsc_field_order`) walks the `.dsc` from its `Dsc` message by `proto/`'s field types, after showing the walk refuses the same artefact with two fields of one atom body swapped. Path: the compiler's encoder, `dsc.encode`'s `rdsc_4a_9_1_expr`, through `ds.wire`'s writer; the defect it meets is the provenance flag appended after the member it marks.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    payload: Json mutable

rule depth:
    Reading r
->
    log info "depth {r.payload.depth}"
